draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialized as JSON with all keys recursively sorted in lexicographic order and all whitespace removed, producing proposal_canon.json. The hash hProposal = sha256(proposal_canon.json) is computed and verified to equal d9dc7a234b213ce4fdf5295fcd2bb6f9af2326bfd51e167d149bde5e0a496b5e. The seed is then derived as seedHex = sha256(hProposal || salt) where salt = 0f5dbcafc1d444fd1c389d647b23ae0140ff8494ec43610f35a1ac58ba942f3a, yielding dc85e4c9dbaeae7a6a6847b4e81abd4d022760523f1d67bbf5698028a69aeade. A third party may reproduce this derivation by hashing the canonical proposal_canon.json file to recover hProposal, then hashing hProposal concatenated with the salt to recover the seed, confirming the mechanical integrity of the witness draw without access to this session.
